name: app-shopping-app-with-3d-garments-on-teal-gradient
title: Fashion shopping app screens with knitwear cutouts in oval frames on a teal gradient
whatItIs: Three white phone screens on a teal gradient. The first has a search field and two-column oval product frames with round arrow buttons and prices; the second a large knitwear image with a 360-degree ring, size pills and Buy Now / Add to Cart buttons; the third a cart list with dashed dividers and quantity steppers.
whatItMeans: Soft, tidy and modern; ovals and pill buttons make shopping feel gentle.
techniques: Frame each product in a tall oval instead of a square.
Show a rotation ring around the hero product.
Use one deep teal for primary buttons and selected states.
Divide cart rows with dashed rules.

vocabulary.definition: A tall elliptical container for a product image.
A ring graphic implying the object can be spun.
Plus and minus controls around a number.
A dotted rule separating list items.
